name: Banner of Heroism 1
description: Summons a Banner anywhere in your sight for 30s.  You and your group within 15 tiles have their defense bolstered, and regen more than their full health over 30s.

name: Commanding Shout 1
description: A commanding shout that greaatly increases the damage and healing of your group within 15 tiles for 2 minutes, scaling with each memeber's strength.

name: Forward Comman 1
description: For 15s your authority carries your next order.  The next shout you cast, will cost 0 Valor.

name: Guard 1
description: Protect an ally, taking 40% of their damage received.  Last 60s, or until you have absorbed half of your own max health.  Only works within 8 tiles.  Damage over time effects will not count.  Damage absorbed CAN kill you.

name: Hold the Line 1
description: For 10s, you and your group within 6 tiles will have a 40% chance to reflect strikes.  Shares a cooldown with other shouts.  Pure only.

name: Press the Attack 1
description: Grants you and your group within 6 tiles 15% attack speed, and 15% cooldown reduction for 20 seconds.  Shares a short cooldown with other shouts.

name: Rally 1
description: Shakes one affliction off each member of your group for 30s and lowers AC.  Shares a short cooldown with other shouts.

name: Rallying Frenzy 1
description: A rallying cry that shares your battle frenzy with your group within 12 tiles, healing each of them when struck for a short time.

name: Second Wind 1
description: Grants you and your group within 6 tiles a barrier worth 12% of each member's own max health.  Shares a short cooldown with other shouts.
